records.text: Donald Trump was a 50 percent owner of Miss America with NBCUniversal when Erika Kirk was crowned.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: More specifically, Donald Trump (Donald J. Trump) was actually the 50 percent owner of Miss America alongside NBC Universal when Erika (Erika Kirk) was crowned.

verification.notes: Trump and NBCUniversal each owned 50 percent of the Miss Universe Organization, which operated Miss USA and Miss Teen USA. Erika Frantzve was crowned Miss Arizona USA, not Miss America. The statement conflates the unrelated Miss America system with Miss USA and is directly contradicted by pageant ownership records.
